title: Introduce compliance-hardened RBAC translator and KMS evidence proxy
author: Maya Nguyen
release_notes: Added a compliance-safe RBAC translation layer and a KMS evidence proxy to ensure per-tenant jurisdiction enforcement and non-repudiable audit forwarding; configurable via feature flags for staged rollout.
description: Context: Several enterprise customers requested stronger guarantees around tenant-level jurisdiction enforcement, KMS provenance, and immutable audit breadcrumbs that survive operator-level routing changes. This PR implements a compliance-hardened RBAC translator that converts high-level RBAC v2 bindings into enforced, region-aware runtime policies, plus a KMS evidence proxy that attaches signed provenance claims to encryption operations and emits an audit envelope to downstream collectors. Motivation: Reduce manual policy mapping, prevent accidental cross-region key usage, and make audit trails tamper-resistant for compliance reviews and legal holds. This change stitches together policy compilation, runtime enforcement hooks, and audit signing without changing the public API surface. Technical summary: 1) rbacv2 translator: new translator service (pkg/translator) that ingests declarative RBAC v2 role bindings and emits per-service decision policies including region pin constraints, operator-scope scoping, and temporal TTLs. Translator uses a permissive-to-strict fallback chain and emits explainable decisions to the policy-trace channel. 2) KMS evidence proxy: lightweight proxy (pkg/kms/prover) that intercepts KMS calls from the runtime, validates tenant residency assertion, attaches a signed evidence envelope (signed with a cluster CMK), and forwards the envelope to the audit-forwarder. The envelope contains non-sensitive provenance (key id, region claim, service nonce, request hash). 3) Audit integration: internal/audit/forwarder updated to accept sealed envelopes, index provenance fields for search, and emit integrity hashes to the ledger. 4) Rollout flags & migration: feature flags feature.translator_v2 and feature.kms_evidence_proxy gate behavior. Translator supports a dry-run mode which logs translated decisions to policy-trace and forwards metrics. Migration plan: enable translator dry-run in staging, run for 2 weeks, review policy-coverage metrics, enable enforcement for a limited tenant cohort via tenant opt-in list, then expand. Enable KMS evidence proxy in passive attach mode (envelope generation only) then switch to attach-and-verify after 1 week of telemetry review. Backout: toggles to disable enforcement and evidence attachment, fallback to legacy routing intact. Testing: unit tests added for translator rule compilation, property tests for region pin constraints, integration e2e test that simulates cross-region KMS requests and asserts envelope emission, added a new compliance_e2e_test that runs on CI with an emulated KMS. Performance: translator adds negligible latency in dry-run; enforcement path adds ~1-2ms at request time due to provenance signing (measured in canary with 95th latency delta +1.9ms). KMS proxy is async by default for audit-forwarding to avoid tail latencies; verification path is sync when verification_required flag is true. Security: evidence envelopes are signed with cluster CMK; audit-forwarder retains only hashed payloads for privacy; RBAC decisions include operator-scope allowlists to prevent privilege escalation. Observability: added metrics: translator.rules_translated_total, translator.enforcement_failures, kms.proofs_emitted_total, audit.envelope_forward_latency_ms. New logs include structured fields for search and an explainable decision JSON emitted to policy-trace. Files changed (high level): services/translator/main.go, pkg/translator/compiler.go, pkg/kms/prover/prover.go, internal/audit/forwarder/handler.go, helm/redwood-private/templates/kms-proxy.yaml, config/feature-flags.yaml, policies/compliance/jurisdiction_rules.yaml, docs/security/kms-residency.md, docs/ops/translator-rollout.md, tests/integration/compliance_e2e_test.go, tests/unit/translator_compiler_test.go, go.mod, go.sum, scripts/ci/runner-compose.yaml.
